package zzframes

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/hex"
	"io"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/ipc"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/json"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/jsonrpc"
)

type rw struct {
	io.Reader
	io.Writer
}

type writeCase struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
	Hex  string `json:"hex"`
}

type readCase struct {
	Name   string          `json:"name"`
	Input  string          `json:"input"`
	Msgs   []json.Value    `json:"messages"`
	Err    string          `json:"error"`
	IsEOF  bool            `json:"eof"`
}

func msgJSON(m *ipc.Message) json.Value {
	type out struct {
		ID     *string            `json:"id"`
		Method string             `json:"method"`
		Params *string            `json:"params"`
		Result *string            `json:"result"`
		Error  *jsonrpc.ResponseError `json:"error"`
		Kind   string             `json:"kind"`
	}
	o := out{Method: m.Method, Error: m.Error}
	if m.ID != nil {
		s, _ := json.Marshal(m.ID)
		ss := string(s)
		o.ID = &ss
	}
	if m.Params != nil {
		s := hex.EncodeToString(m.Params)
		o.Params = &s
	}
	if m.Result != nil {
		s := hex.EncodeToString(m.Result)
		o.Result = &s
	}
	switch {
	case m.IsRequest():
		o.Kind = "request"
	case m.IsNotification():
		o.Kind = "notification"
	case m.IsResponse():
		o.Kind = "response"
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(o)
	return b
}

func readAll(p ipc.Protocol) ([]json.Value, error) {
	var msgs []json.Value
	for {
		m, err := p.ReadMessage()
		if err != nil {
			return msgs, err
		}
		msgs = append(msgs, msgJSON(m))
	}
}

func TestDumpFrames(t *testing.T) {
	astral := "/proj/src/\U0001F600-\u00e9-\U0001D7D8.ts"
	big := bytes.Repeat([]byte("x"), 300)
	huge := bytes.Repeat([]byte("y"), 70000)
	var writes []writeCase
	mp := func(name string, f func(p *MessagePackProtocol)) {
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		f(NewMessagePackProtocol(&rw{Reader: &bytes.Buffer{}, Writer: &buf}))
		writes = append(writes, writeCase{Name: "msgpack/" + name, Hex: hex.EncodeToString(buf.Bytes())})
	}
	js := func(name string, f func(p *ipc.JSONRPCProtocol)) {
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		f(ipc.NewJSONRPCProtocol(&rw{Reader: &bytes.Buffer{}, Writer: &buf}))
		writes = append(writes, writeCase{Name: "jsonrpc/" + name, Hex: hex.EncodeToString(buf.Bytes())})
	}
	mp("call_readFile", func(p *MessagePackProtocol) { p.WriteRequest(jsonrpc.NewIDString("readFile"), "readFile", astral) })
	mp("call_nil", func(p *MessagePackProtocol) { p.WriteRequest(jsonrpc.NewIDString("x"), "x", nil) })
	mp("call_writeFile", func(p *MessagePackProtocol) {
		p.WriteRequest(nil, "writeFile", struct {
			Path string `json:"path"`
			Data string `json:"data"`
		}{astral, "a<b>&\"\\\n\u2028"})
	})
	mp("response_json", func(p *MessagePackProtocol) { p.WriteResponse(jsonrpc.NewIDString("ping"), json.Value(`"pong"`)) })
	mp("response_nil", func(p *MessagePackProtocol) { p.WriteResponse(jsonrpc.NewIDString("release"), nil) })
	mp("response_binary_astral", func(p *MessagePackProtocol) { p.WriteResponse(jsonrpc.NewIDString("echo"), RawBinary(astral)) })
	mp("response_binary_empty", func(p *MessagePackProtocol) { p.WriteResponse(jsonrpc.NewIDString("getSourceFile"), RawBinary(nil)) })
	mp("response_bin16", func(p *MessagePackProtocol) { p.WriteResponse(jsonrpc.NewIDString("echo"), RawBinary(big)) })
	mp("response_bin32", func(p *MessagePackProtocol) { p.WriteResponse(jsonrpc.NewIDString("echo"), RawBinary(huge)) })
	mp("error", func(p *MessagePackProtocol) {
		p.WriteError(jsonrpc.NewIDString("getSymbol"), &jsonrpc.ResponseError{Code: jsonrpc.CodeInternalError, Message: "api: client error: symbol \U0001F600 not found"})
	})
	mp("error_empty_id", func(p *MessagePackProtocol) {
		p.WriteError(jsonrpc.NewIDString(""), &jsonrpc.ResponseError{Code: jsonrpc.CodeInternalError, Message: "x"})
	})
	js("request_readFile", func(p *ipc.JSONRPCProtocol) { p.WriteRequest(jsonrpc.NewIDString("api1"), "readFile", astral) })
	js("request_nil_params", func(p *ipc.JSONRPCProtocol) { p.WriteRequest(jsonrpc.NewIDString("api2"), "x", nil) })
	js("notification", func(p *ipc.JSONRPCProtocol) { p.WriteNotification("note", json.Value(`{"a":1}`)) })
	js("response_int_id", func(p *ipc.JSONRPCProtocol) { p.WriteResponse(jsonrpc.NewIDInt(7), json.Value(`{"b":[1,2]}`)) })
	js("response_str_id", func(p *ipc.JSONRPCProtocol) { p.WriteResponse(jsonrpc.NewIDString("q"), json.Value(`"`+astral+`"`)) })
	js("response_nil", func(p *ipc.JSONRPCProtocol) { p.WriteResponse(jsonrpc.NewIDInt(3), nil) })
	js("response_binary", func(p *ipc.JSONRPCProtocol) { p.WriteResponse(jsonrpc.NewIDInt(4), RawBinary(astral)) })
	js("error", func(p *ipc.JSONRPCProtocol) {
		p.WriteError(jsonrpc.NewIDInt(9), &jsonrpc.ResponseError{Code: jsonrpc.CodeInternalError, Message: "boom \U0001F600"})
	})

	var reads []readCase
	rd := func(name string, input []byte, mk func(r io.Reader) ipc.Protocol) {
		msgs, err := readAll(mk(bytes.NewReader(input)))
		c := readCase{Name: name, Input: hex.EncodeToString(input), Msgs: msgs}
		if err == io.EOF {
			c.IsEOF = true
		} else if err != nil {
			c.Err = err.Error()
		}
		reads = append(reads, c)
	}
	mpr := func(r io.Reader) ipc.Protocol { return NewMessagePackProtocol(&rw{Reader: r, Writer: io.Discard}) }
	jsr := func(r io.Reader) ipc.Protocol { return ipc.NewJSONRPCProtocol(&rw{Reader: r, Writer: io.Discard}) }
	tuple := func(typ byte, method, payload []byte) []byte {
		var b bytes.Buffer
		w := NewMessagePackProtocol(&rw{Reader: &bytes.Buffer{}, Writer: &b})
		w.writeTuple(MessageType(typ), string(method), payload)
		return b.Bytes()
	}
	cat := func(parts ...[]byte) []byte { return bytes.Join(parts, nil) }
	rd("msgpack/multi", cat(
		tuple(1, []byte("getSourceFile"), []byte(`{"snapshot":"n1","file":"`+astral+`"}`)),
		tuple(2, []byte("readFile"), []byte(`{"kind":"value","value":"x"}`)),
		tuple(3, []byte("fileExists"), []byte("Error: boom")),
		tuple(1, []byte("getServerTiming"), nil),
		[]byte{0x93, 0xcc, 0x01, 0xc4, 0x04, 'p', 'i', 'n', 'g', 0xc4, 0x00},
	), mpr)
	rd("msgpack/empty_method_request", tuple(1, nil, []byte("{}")), mpr)
	rd("msgpack/bad_marker", []byte{0x92, 0x01}, mpr)
	rd("msgpack/bad_type_marker", []byte{0x93, 0xd0, 0x01}, mpr)
	rd("msgpack/unknown_type", []byte{0x93, 0x07}, mpr)
	rd("msgpack/zero_type", []byte{0x93, 0x00}, mpr)
	rd("msgpack/client_sent_response", tuple(4, []byte("x"), nil), mpr)
	rd("msgpack/bad_bin", []byte{0x93, 0x01, 0xa4, 'p', 'i', 'n', 'g'}, mpr)
	rd("msgpack/truncated_payload", cat(tuple(1, []byte("a"), []byte("b")), []byte{0x93, 0x01, 0xc4, 0x01, 'p', 0xc4, 0x05, 'a', 'b'}), mpr)
	rd("msgpack/eof_in_header", []byte{0x93, 0x01}, mpr)
	frame := func(body string) []byte { return []byte("Content-Length: " + itoa(len(body)) + "\r\n\r\n" + body) }
	rd("jsonrpc/multi", cat(
		frame(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize"}`),
		frame(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"s","method":"getSourceFile","params":{"file":"`+astral+`"}}`),
		frame(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"api1","result":{"kind":"value","value":"\ud83d\ude00"}}`),
		frame(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"api2","error":{"code":-32603,"message":"nope","data":{"x":1}}}`),
		frame(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"$/cancelRequest","params":{"id":1}}`),
		[]byte("Content-Type: application/vscode-jsonrpc; charset=utf-8\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\n\r\n{}"),
		frame(`{"id":2,"method":"ping","extra":true}`),
		frame(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":null,"method":"n"}`),
	), jsr)
	rd("jsonrpc/bad_version", frame(`{"jsonrpc":"1.0","id":1,"method":"x"}`), jsr)
	rd("jsonrpc/no_content_length", []byte("X: 1\r\n\r\n{}"), jsr)
	rd("jsonrpc/negative_length", []byte("Content-Length: -1\r\n\r\n"), jsr)
	rd("jsonrpc/bad_length", []byte("Content-Length: 1x\r\n\r\n"), jsr)
	rd("jsonrpc/bad_header", []byte("garbage\r\n\r\n"), jsr)
	rd("jsonrpc/truncated_body", []byte("Content-Length: 10\r\n\r\n{\"a\""), jsr)
	rd("jsonrpc/eof_in_header", []byte("Content-Len"), jsr)
	rd("jsonrpc/invalid_json", frame(`{"id":1,`), jsr)
	rd("jsonrpc/float_id", frame(`{"id":1.5,"method":"x"}`), jsr)
	rd("jsonrpc/duplicate_key", frame(`{"id":1,"id":2,"method":"x"}`), jsr)

	out, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"writes": writes, "reads": reads})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("FRAMES_OUT"), out, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func itoa(n int) string {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(n)
	return string(b)
}
